roadmap.title: Story and early setup
roadmap.description: Play the story chapters and the Drift, Off-road and Race branches while you level REP. Do the free garage tasks, tuning wins and daily challenge whenever convenient.

roadmap.title: REP 50 and late-game events
roadmap.description: Level to REP 50 and finish the Race story, then buy a top car such as the Koenigsegg Regera for the Heat, speed and Discovery achievements, and work through the collectibles and activities as you drive.

roadmap.title: Perfect activities and online cleanup
roadmap.description: Three-star every activity, finish the last collectibles, and complete the online and Crew goals.

achievements.description: Pick your first ride.
achievements.summary: Choose your first car after creating your character.

steps.text: Finish character creation, then pick your first car when the game offers it.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1 of the story.

steps.text: Play the story missions until Chapter 1 ends.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2 of the story.

steps.text: Play the story missions until Chapter 2 ends.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 3 of the story.

steps.text: Play the story missions until Chapter 3 ends.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4, the final chapter of the corrupt-cop storyline.

steps.text: Play the story missions until Chapter 4 ends.

achievements.description: Take down 100 Cop Vehicles
achievements.summary: Take down 100 cop vehicles.

guide.context: The Damage Increase passive auxiliary part helps you wreck cars by ramming.

steps.text: Wreck cop cars during night chases. Leading them over a ramp crashes the ones that follow.
Farm the @loc{Abandon Ship!} long jump over water in @loc{Port Murphy} at Heat 3 or 4, so faster cops follow you over the jump.

achievements.description: Hit 240 mph using any car.
achievements.summary: Reach a speed of 240 mph (386 km/h) in any car.

guide.context: A near-top car is needed; a swapped engine in a lower car also works.

steps.text: Buy the Koenigsegg Regera and equip single-use large nitrous such as the 12 lb Elite.
Drive a long, wide straight, such as a highway, and use the nitrous until you pass 240 mph.

achievements.description: Get a 3 Star Rating on all the Activities in the game
achievements.summary: Get the maximum 3-star result on every Speed Trap, Long Jump and Drift Zone.

guide.context: The map holds 120 activities in total. Many 3-star targets need near-maxed cars, so do them late.

steps.text: Finish the Speed Trap, Long Jump and Drift Zone checklists, then replay any that have fewer than 3 stars.
Use a maxed car such as the Koenigsegg Regera on roads, and a drift or off-road setup where needed. Pause > Progression > Collections shows what is left in each district.

achievements.description: Change the text on the License Plate
achievements.summary: Edit your car's license plate text.

steps.text: In the garage, open Customization > Body, rotate to the back of the car, edit the plate text, and accept.

achievements.description: Beat your first Crew Time Trial
achievements.summary: Beat your first Crew Time Trial.

steps.text: Start a daytime event with the stopwatch icon on the map.
Beat the Bronze ghost time, which is lenient.

achievements.description: Smash your way through all the Billboards
achievements.summary: Smash all 85 Billboards.

guide.context: Billboards sit at the end of ramps. They appear on the map when you drive near. Check Pause > Progression > Collections to see how many remain in each district.

achievements.description: Win a race with a car at 399 Performance Rating
achievements.summary: Win a race with a car rated 400 or higher.

steps.text: Buy the Koenigsegg Regera, which starts above 400 rating, and win any race with it.

achievements.description: Get all Collectibles and 3 stars on all Activities
achievements.summary: Collect every collectible and earn 3 stars on every activity.

guide.context: Finishing both sets also unlocks the Ferrari 488 Pista.

steps.text: Smash all 85 Billboards, collect all 130 Street Art and all 100 Flamingos.
Earn 3 stars on all 45 Speed Traps, 40 Long Jumps and 35 Drift Zones.

achievements.description: Go from last to first place during the final lap of a race and win
achievements.summary: Start the last lap of a circuit race in last place and finish first.

steps.text: Use a strong car and set the race difficulty to easy with the race rating at 120 so rivals are slow.
Stay at the back until the final lap starts, then pass everyone and win. A short circuit like Tornado in @loc{Downtown Palm City} works well.

achievements.description: Complete the Drift driving story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Drift driving story.

steps.text: Follow the Drift story missions to the end. This branch has the lowest REP requirement of the three.

achievements.description: Complete the Off-road driving story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Off-road driving story.

steps.text: Follow the Off-road story missions to the end. It opens about halfway through the game.

achievements.description: Complete the Race driving story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Race driving story.

guide.context: The branch is open from the start, but the last Dex missions unlock late.

steps.text: Follow the Race story missions from @npc{Dex} to the end.
Keep levelling REP; the final races need a high REP level and a car near 350 rating.

achievements.description: Customize a vehicle with a wrap
achievements.summary: Customize a vehicle with a wrap.

steps.text: In the garage, open Customization > Paint & Wrap > Edit Wrap > Decals.
Choose a body section, add any decal, accept its placement, back out, and select Save Changes.

achievements.description: Complete your first Daily Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete your first Daily Challenge.

steps.text: Pause, open Social, and select Challenges to see the five daily challenges.
Finish any one of them.

achievements.description: Complete all Drift Zones
achievements.summary: Complete all 35 Drift Zones.

guide.context: Drift Zones appear after the drift tutorial. Use a drift-leaning car such as a Mazda RX-7, Nissan 350Z, Corvette or SRT Viper GTS, and an off-road setup for dirt zones. The Koenigsegg Regera is a poor drifter. Check Pause > Progression > Collections to see how many remain in each district.

achievements.description: Win a race with parts equipped in both auxiliary part slots
achievements.summary: Win any race with a part in each of your two auxiliary slots.

steps.text: In the Performance menu, buy a part for each of the two auxiliary slots at the far right, which unlock around REP 15, and equip both.
Win any race.

achievements.description: Win a race with all vehicle effects slots equipped
achievements.summary: Win a race with every vehicle effects slot filled.

steps.text: Open Customization > Effects and buy one item for each slot. The cheapest starter set costs about $37,500.
Equip all of them and win any race.

achievements.description: Escape 100 Cop Chases
achievements.summary: Escape 100 cop chases.

guide.context: You cannot escape while a Heat 5 helicopter is aimed at you.

steps.text: At night, get out of every cop's sight by leaving the red circle on the minimap.
To farm, stay at low Heat and use the @loc{Abandon Ship!} jump in @loc{Port Murphy}. Slow cops stop at the water, so the chase ends. Then let them spot you again and repeat.

achievements.description: Complete 25 events online with other players
achievements.summary: Finish 25 online events alongside other players.

steps.text: Repeat online events until you have finished 25. Wins are not required.
Quick races speed this up: Tornado in @loc{Downtown Palm City}, Vertigo in @loc{Eden Shores}, or the Resort circuit at @loc{Palm City Raceway}.

achievements.description: Complete 5 events online with other players
achievements.summary: Finish 5 online events alongside other players.

guide.context: A player who leaves or fails to finish still counts as long as the event started.

steps.text: Accept an invite from a nearby player, or start an event and invite players in your lobby.
Finish 5 events. Wins are not required.

steps.text: At night, drive to a gas station once your damage bar is in its last section (under about half).
Repair there. Each gas station allows 3 repairs per night.

achievements.description: Win a High Heat 5 race and return to garage safely
achievements.summary: Win the Heat 5 night race, then reach a safe house without being busted.

guide.context: High Heat races appear at night, one at Heat 3 and one at Heat 5.

steps.text: Drive at night until your Heat reaches 5, then start the High Heat 5 race and win it.
After the win, drive to any safe house without being busted to bank the reward.

achievements.description: Reach max Crew Level with your Crew
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum Crew Level of 50 with your Crew.

steps.text: Join a Crew that is already level 50. Your REP adds to the Crew level, so doing it alone is very slow.
Stay in that Crew until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Win a race with handling parts for maximum drift equipped
achievements.summary: Win a race with handling parts tuned for maximum drift.

guide.context: Handling comes from Suspension, Tires and Differential. The tuning graph shows a white dot; its position sets the handling type.

steps.text: Change Suspension, Tires and Differential until the white dot touches the right edge of the graph.
Win any race.

achievements.description: Win a race with handling parts for maximum off-road traction equipped
achievements.summary: Win a race with handling parts tuned for maximum off-road traction.

guide.context: Handling comes from Suspension, Tires and Differential. The tuning graph shows a white dot; its position sets the handling type.

steps.text: Change Suspension, Tires and Differential until the white dot touches the top edge of the graph.
Win any race.

achievements.description: Win a race with handling parts for maximum road traction equipped
achievements.summary: Win a race with handling parts tuned for maximum road traction.

guide.context: Handling comes from Suspension, Tires and Differential. The tuning graph shows a white dot; its position sets the handling type.

steps.text: Change Suspension, Tires and Differential until the white dot touches the bottom edge of the graph.
Win any race.

achievements.description: Win a race with handling parts for maximum race equipped
achievements.summary: Win a race with handling parts tuned for maximum race handling.

guide.context: Handling comes from Suspension, Tires and Differential. The tuning graph shows a white dot; its position sets the handling type.

steps.text: Change Suspension, Tires and Differential until the white dot touches the left edge of the graph.
Win any race.

achievements.description: Reach REP Level 2
achievements.summary: Reach REP Level 2.

steps.text: Race or complete missions until you reach REP Level 2. This happens early in the game.

achievements.description: Reach REP Level 50
achievements.summary: Reach REP Level 50.

guide.context: Banked night REP is multiplied by your Heat level when you reach a safe house, so riskier runs pay more.

steps.text: Earn REP from races, missions and chases. REP earned at night is banked only when you reach a safe house.
Faster option: at night with Heat 5, drive back and forth through the two Speed Traps in @loc{Downtown Palm City} for three stars each.

achievements.description: Earn and bank 1 000 000 REP during one night
achievements.summary: Bank 1,000,000 REP in a single night.

guide.context: The REP only counts once you reach a safe house without being busted.

steps.text: Reach Heat 5 at night. The displayed REP includes your Heat multiplier, so you need about 200,000 base REP with the 5x multiplier.
Easy route at REP 45 to 50: run the three Discovery events A, B and C in order, about 48,000 REP each the first time, then add other events.
Alternative route: with Heat 5 in @loc{Downtown Palm City}, three-star the two Speed Traps again and again.
Drive to a safe house without being busted to bank the total.

achievements.summary: Complete all 45 Speed Traps.

achievements.description: Win a race in a vehicle with an engine swap
achievements.summary: Win any race using a car with a swapped engine.

steps.text: In a car's Performance menu, open Swap Engine and buy a swap. It is expensive, so wait until you have money.
Win any race with the swapped car.

achievements.description: Win the Discovery Event
achievements.summary: Win the Discovery Event.

steps.text: After reaching REP 50, start the Discovery night race, which takes about 9 minutes, in a car rated 400+, such as the Koenigsegg Regera.
Win it. You can also use it for the 400+ rating win.

achievements.description: Win a race in a vehicle with tuned exhaust sound
achievements.summary: Win any race using a car whose exhaust sound you changed.

steps.text: In the Customization menu, open the exhaust sound sliders on the far right, change any slider, and accept.
Win any race with that car.
